items.q: What is the FISAT Rover Team?
items.a: A student engineering team from the Federal Institute of Science and Technology, Angamaly, Kerala. We design and build Mars rover prototypes to compete at the International Rover Challenge.
DAWN is our current-season rover: a Mars-analogue prototype with a rocker-bogie suspension, a multi-DOF robotic arm and vision-guided autonomy.

items.q: Which competition do you compete in?
items.a: The International Rover Challenge (IRC), a premier global rover competition. Our current campaign is IRC 2026.
Six departments: Design & Manufacturing, Electrical, Controls & Embedded, AI & Autonomy, Science, and Research & Documentation. Each drives DAWN from a different angle.

Yes. We work with sponsors across three tiers — Platinum, Gold and Regular — and we tailor deliverables around your brand and recruiting goals. See the Sponsor Plaza in-experience or contact us directly.

items.q: How do I join the team?
items.a: The Recruitment Center in this experience explains our intake process. In short: FISAT students apply, interview with the relevant department, and complete an onboarding project before joining a sub-team.
